newsitem.title: UK: Barclays leads sector down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Barclays leads sector down on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc led the UK bank sector lower on Friday as investors took profits ahead of next Monday's Halifax Building Society flotation, dealers said.
UK financial stocks were lifted to record peaks in recent weeks as investors scooped up shares ahead of the flotation.
By 1010 GMT, Barclays shares were off 33p, or 2.7 percent, at 1186-1/2.

Shares in Abbey National Plc were down 20p to 881-1/2, and National Westminster Bank Plc lost 16-1/2p to 749. Shares in Standard Chartered eased 11p to 975, while Lloyds TSB Group Plc slipped 9p to 619-1/2.

HSBC Holdings Plc shares bucked the sector's trend, climbing 11p to 1890-1/2, bolstered by a record-setting rally in Hong Stock shares, dealers said. -- Debra Sherman, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
